LanguageData.XPC_Curve_CurvatureHelp: Curvature: 0–200%. The specified anchor multiplier stays fixed.
LanguageData.XPC_Curve_FurtherCurvatureHelp: Curvature: 0–200%. The configured anchor multiplier stays fixed.
LanguageData.XPC_Curve_GwsCurvatureHelp: Curvature changes curve shape, not the chosen anchor multiplier. 0% = mild, 200% = strong.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_AnchorLimitHelp: Asymptotic limit. High anchor remains exact; values stay below this limit.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_AnchorSafetyHelp: Hard technical cap, not a theoretical limit. The chosen high anchor remains exact.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_FurtherLimitHelp: Asymptotic limit; the high anchor stays exact.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_FurtherSafetyHelp: Hard cap; the high anchor stays exact.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_Description: Adjust how consciousness affects skill learning.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_ResetDefaultsTip: Restore Speed, Capacity and Further V2 curves. Master and sub-switches remain unchanged.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_ResetVanillaTip: Disable only XP Customizer Consciousness effects. Other tabs, including GWS and Learning, are unchanged.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_AnchorIntro: 100% consciousness = x1.00. Speed and capacity have separate curves.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_FurtherIntro: Post-cap base efficiency x Consciousness multiplier + Mental threshold adjustment (pp).
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_FurtherCurrentDetail: Preview base post-cap efficiency: {0}% (Learning tab setting)
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_FurtherPreviewHelp: Preview only: Mental Threshold adjustment excluded. Custom values never change gameplay settings.
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_FurtherLowPreview: Low consciousness -> multiplier and post-cap efficiency
LanguageData.XPC_Cons_FurtherHighPreview: High consciousness -> multiplier and post-cap efficiency
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_Description: Multiply learning speed by Global Work Speed. Work speed, daily XP capacity and direct XP are not changed.
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_DisabledHelp: OFF: Vanilla learning speed preserved. Saved GWS settings retained.
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_SkillsHelp: Shooting, Melee and Social default OFF. Other nine skills default ON; learning only.
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_SkillsReset: Reset skill selection (Shooting / Melee / Social OFF)
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_LimitHelp: High GWS approaches this limit; the selected anchor keeps its configured multiplier.
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_SafetyHelp: Linear and Accelerating may grow beyond the selected anchor. The safety cap still applies.
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_ReadingEnabled: Apply GWS to reading XP (optional; default OFF)
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_ReadingHelp: OFF: ordinary reading Intellectual XP and textbook skill XP bypass GWS only. Book XP settings are unchanged.
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_ResetDefaultsTip: Restore GWS anchor positions, factors, curves, curvature and default skill choices. Master, Low/High and reading switches stay as set.
LanguageData.XPC_Gws_ResetVanillaTip: Disable GWS effects and reset only GWS settings. Other XP Customizer tabs are unchanged.
